response.sql: SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL) AS share_of_total, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major)) AS ratio_to_avg FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC LIMIT 10
